title: Dashboard overview
description: An account overview: app header with a command menu, notifications and account menus, KPI tiles, an alert, recent activity and a quick-action form.
docs: Render <DashboardOverview /> inside your ThemeScope (it follows the theme, scheme, density and locale around it). Its copy and data live in components/dashboard-overview/dashboard-overview.content.ts: pass your own object as `content` to translate or rebrand it.
